leadership.name: Poonam Kumari
leadership.bio: Poonam founded VSJ AI Labs with a vision to build compliance-first AI and enterprise technology that helps organizations modernize operations, improve efficiency, and accelerate digital transformation. She owns business strategy, P&L, client success, partnerships, and organizational growth — keeping every engagement aligned with industry standards, regulatory expectations, and the measurable outcomes customers actually ask for. Her focus is on building VSJ into a long-term, trusted partner for BFSI, Healthcare, and Enterprise SaaS leaders.

leadership.name: Ashutosh Kumar Sundram
leadership.bio: Ashutosh co-founded VSJ AI Labs bringing a data-first perspective to how modern enterprises build with technology. He holds an MBA in Information Technology with a Data Analytics specialization from Symbiosis Institute of Computer Studies & Research (SICSR), Pune, and combines that with hands-on experience in ETL pipelines, business intelligence, and analytics workflows across Python, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and Snowflake. At VSJ he partners with Poonam on business strategy, product decisions, and the data-and-analytics side of client engagements — helping shape how VSJ turns raw data into measurable outcomes.
